entries.name: Rally at the Blow
entries.effect: After an ally within 3 takes HP damage: reduce Frightened 1; ward its next defense.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Move a willing soldier into the gap, then use the saber to preserve a withdrawal lane. Avoid spending allies' Reactions merely for appearance.

**Encounter and conversation:** An orderly withdrawal is a victory the marshal may accept if the wounded can leave safely.

**Habitat:** Settlement; frontier; contested road · **Communication:** Common and its community’s language

**Loot:** Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-hobgoblin-marshal


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 31

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Command saber | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Push 1. | 8 physical damage. Push 3. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/8

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=5.539. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [commanding step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/commanding-step.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [Rally at the Blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/rally-at-the-blow.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Make Room

*A clipped order sends one companion into the opening before it closes.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-commanding-step


**Action:** Maneuver
